zh-Hans: 我要看清他跟我的跑法差在哪儿，把本事学过来！
en: I'll watch how his driving differs from mine and pick up his techniques!
I can't keep up at all!

zh-Hans: 为什么？车都变成那样了，他还控制得住？！
en: How? How can he still control the car like that?!

zh-Hans: 哇！这到底跑到多少公里了？！
en: Whoa! How fast are we going?!

zh-Hans: 喂喂，一上来就动真格啊？
en: Hey, are you going all out already?

zh-Hans: 太快了吧！再怎么说，这速度也……
en: Isn't this too fast? No matter how you look at it...

zh-Hans: 他的入弯速度，说不定比拓海还快！
en: His corner entry might even be faster than Takumi's!
Agh, damn it! Is that not enough?!

zh-Hans: 太厉害了，厉害得我根本看不懂发生了什么！
en: Amazing. He's so good I can't even tell what he's doing!

zh-Hans: 水平差太远，连参考都参考不了。
en: He's so far above me, I can't even learn from it.

zh-Hans: 被你逼成这样，我反倒更不想让了！
en: Push me that hard, and I'll want to hold my ground even more!

zh-Hans: 你还不是我这辆 S13 的对手！
en: You're still no match for my S13!
Looks like you let your guard down.
All right, time to let it rip!

zh-Hans: 用手刹甩动车尾的诀窍，我已经掌握得差不多了！
en: I'm really getting the hang of kicking the rear out with the handbrake!

zh-Hans: 原来我的 SILVIA 真有这么快吗？
en: Was my SILVIA really this fast all along?

zh-Hans: 终于要冲进第一个弯了！
拼了！让你见识 SPEED STARS 的实力！
en: Let's do this! I'll show you what the Speed Stars can do!

zh-Hans: 我不会输，让你见识本地车手的底气！
en: I won't lose! I'll show you what the locals are made of!
